paragraphs: Corti sells AI infrastructure to developers building healthcare and life science software. The pitch is that a team can ship clinical features without standing up the model infrastructure underneath.

Everything runs on one model delivered through four capabilities: speech to text, text generation, medical coding, and a framework for building agents. A single API call returns structured predictions along with supporting evidence and an audit trail. Common builds include an ambient scribe that captures a visit as it happens and turns it into a structured note. For electronic health record vendors, the same components are pitched as AI embedded in the core of the record system. Pricing is usage based and metered in credits.

Corti says more than a million patients receive care each week from providers using it. The about page describes a team spread across nine countries. The company states that every capability ships with HIPAA, GDPR, SOC 2, ISO 27001 and ISO 42001 built in. It also says its research is published at NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, ACL and npj Digital Medicine.
